# omni-ring

> `omni-ring` is a production-grade, zero-external-dependency (NumPy + standard library + AVX2 C-kernel) implementation of the OMNIRING Coprime Resonator Hyperdimensional Engine and the Two-Faced Polymorphic Bus with shared-memory (`/dev/shm`) IPC.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring && cd omni-ring && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q numpy pytest && ./build_kernel.sh && python3 -m pytest -q` (expect: passed).
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free trial for evaluation).
